description: This file contains unit tests for the VacancyListRestController functionality within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It verifies correct handling of GET requests with various parameters, and ensures that methods for PUT, POST, and DELETE requests throw NotImplemented exceptions.

classes.name: VacancyListRestControllerTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing VacancyListRestController functionality in the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Sets up test data from a YAML fixture file before all tests run.

methods.name: testHandleGetRequest
methods.description: Tests handling of a basic GET request and verifies the response contains expected vacancy data.

methods.name: testHandleGetRequestCount
methods.description: Tests that the GET request returns the expected number of vacancy records.

methods.name: testHandleGetRequestWithLimit
methods.description: Tests GET request handling with a limit parameter and verifies only the specified number of records are returned.

methods.name: testHandleGetRequestWithOffset
methods.description: Tests GET request handling with an offset parameter and verifies the correct vacancy record is returned.

methods.name: testHandlePutRequest
methods.description: Verifies that the PUT request handling throws a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testInitPutValidationRule
methods.description: Verifies that initPutValidationRule throws a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testHandlePostRequest
methods.description: Verifies that POST request handling throws a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testInitPostValidationRule
methods.description: Verifies that initPostValidationRule throws a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testHandleDeleteRequest
methods.description: Verifies that DELETE request handling throws a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testInitDeleteValidationRule
methods.description: Verifies that initDeleteValidationRule throws a NotImplementedException.
